title: Why Undead
html: Undead comes out on top because of Touch of the Grave: your attacks sometimes drain the boss and heal you. Blizzard only says it drains "up to" 5% of your health, and we count the full amount. If it heals for less in game, the gap to the other races shrinks, and another race may be as good.

title: Low-health buttons
html: The sim doesn't wait for you to get low. Shield Wall is used near the end of the fight, and Last Stand and health potions aren't used at all. In game, use them when you need them: that's on top of what's shown here.

title: No bubbles
html: Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Lay on Hands aren't used: a tank under a bubble loses the boss to someone else. Templar's Bulwark is used on cooldown instead, and it shares Forbearance with them.

title: Bear Form threat
html: Bear Form's threat bonus follows Blizzard's patch notes (+115%), not the older tooltip (+50%). If the notes are wrong in game, bears make a lot less threat than shown here.

title: Furor
html: Furor's Rage is wasted when you shift into Bear Form before the pull, so none of the setups take it.

title: Max threat and Balanced
html: These two are the same setup in practice: they only differ in when Maul is queued.

title: Earth Shock threat
html: Earth Shock counts as twice its damage in threat, as in Classic. Forever's tooltip only says it causes "a high amount of threat". If it's less in game, the Warden loses most of its lead in Safe DPS.

title: More damage taken
html: The Warden has no plate and no Shield Block, so it takes more damage than the other tanks and needs the most healing. Its threat comes early instead: Earth Shock with a full mana bar, Stormstrike and totems before the pull.
